Designed a modular end-effector actuation mechanism supporting a 4-DOF tooltip with easily-changeable attachments exceeding 50N of tension force per DOF

work.name: Medical Robotics Engineering Research Assistant
work.description: Designed a novel neurosurgical robot prototype aimed at removing inner-brain tumors, including PCB design and KiCAD schematics.
bulletPoints: Iterated over 20 prototype designs, designing CAD for robot components in Fusion 360, and performing static stress FEA simulations to predict deformation under load
Designed schematic and board layout in KiCAD for a 4-layer PCB incorporating multiple voltage levels (3.3V-12V) and signal protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, etc); iterated over 5 times

Designed PCB to support over 20 motors, 20+ I2C encoders, numerous add-on sensors, IR sensors, and heat-readings using a combination of 2 Teensy 4.1 microcontrollers communicating via a custom SPI communication protocol

work.name: Robotics Engineering Research Assistant
work.company: IMPACT Engineering Lab @ University of Windsor
work.description: Designed and manufactured a novel compliant soft-robotic gripper for agricultural produce handling; paper manuscript in progress.
bulletPoints: Designed and manufactured a novel compliant soft-robotic gripper that uses complex rigid-body geometry and custom-tuned servos to switch its state from flexible to rigid for agricultural produce handling
Incorporated silicone molding, FDM-3D printing, and a rotational-linear motion converter to grip fruits 4cm-12cm in diameter
Wrote computer-vision software in OpenCV and Python to monitor fruit displacement in real-time

Conducted over 300 trials, including control trials, proving gripper durability, functionality, and repeatability on varying size/textured fruits using statistical analysis (t-tests, anova, shapiro-wilks)
Writing a paper manuscript on the gripper (in progress)
